---

**What would you like**
A clear and concise description of the change.

**Why**
What it would make better, or which problem it solves. Ex. "The pet bar covers my cast bar when [...]"

**Alternatives you have tried**
Settings in `/aui` or `/eui` you already looked at, or other ways you got close.

**Anything else**
Screenshots or references to another interface that does this well.

---

AritlokUI is for World of Warcraft: Forever only. It styles and arranges EllesmereUI; it does not read the combat log and does not automate combat decisions, so requests in those directions will be declined.
